batch_notes: Low anchors were Putin and, to a lesser extent, Erdoğan/Bolsonaro/Marcos Jr.; high anchors were Biden and Kishida, with Modi and Jokowi also landing in the upper band. The median cluster sits in the 3.5-6.0 range because many dossiers combine real scrutiny with only partial personal-nexus proof.

I treated official self-report as positive only when paired with a concrete act, filing, correction, appointment, or enforcement step. Allegation-only material was discounted unless the dossier added a direct attribution chain or an external finding.
